Summary.Description: Move a slider: changes are applied live to all selected lights. Untouched settings remain unchanged. Use the button below for a final save and value verification.

Help.Bright: Distance of the bright light region.
Help.Dim: Distance of the dim light region.
Help.DarknessMin: Upper slider: the lower darkness threshold from which the light can be active. It cannot exceed the maximum.
Help.DarknessMax: Lower slider: the upper darkness threshold until which the light remains active. It cannot be below the minimum.
Help.AnimationSpeed: Speed of the selected light animation.
Help.AnimationIntensity: Intensity of the selected light animation.
Help.Walls: The light is constrained by nearby walls and surfaces.
Help.Vision: The light source can provide vision to tokens.
Help.Saturation: Color saturation of the lighting effect.
Help.Attenuation: How strongly light fades toward its edge.
Help.Priority: Priority when light and darkness sources overlap.
Help.Elevation: Vertical elevation of the light source.
Help.Negative: Creates an area of artificial darkness instead of light.

Darkness.Intro: Set the darkness interval like Foundry’s light configuration: “Between min and max”.
Darkness.Explanation: The light is active only while scene darkness is between Minimum and Maximum. 0% = bright, 100% = fully dark.

Status.Error: Save failed — use the button below to retry.
Status.VerifyError: Verification failed — see the browser console for details.

Notifications.SceneNotReady: The scene is not ready yet.
Notifications.SelectLights: Select at least one light source on the scene first.
Notifications.Saved: Changes saved and verified for {count} selected light source(s).
Notifications.SceneMissing: The original scene is no longer available.
Notifications.VerifyError: Not all changes could be verified. See the browser console for details.
Notifications.SceneChanged: The scene changed. Changes were not applied to a different scene.
Notifications.LightMissing: At least one selected light source no longer exists. Reopen the editor.
Notifications.DarknessInvalid: Invalid darkness range. Values must be between 0 and 1, and “Active from” cannot be greater than “Active until”.
Notifications.UpdateMismatch: Foundry did not save all light values as expected. See the browser console for details.
Notifications.SaveFailed: The light values could not be saved. Use the button below to try again.
